rationale: Motor vehicle collision with significant structural damage to the policyholder's car and bodily injury to the policyholder—clearly an auto claim.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at approximately 35 mph on Route 9 yesterday morning around 8:15 am, resulting in a totaled vehicle with the trunk crushed into the back seat. The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. The other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report. This high-severity collision requires immediate adjuster assessment and injury follow-up.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
